why: Every top-level key of culprit.yaml. Both readers of the file read this list: the Go loader (cli/internal/extract.Manifest's yaml tags) and the API's model (api/app/model/manifest.py, Manifest's fields). A test in each fails unless its keys equal it exactly.

Phase 37 part 1 (PERFORMANCE_PLAN.md, end of Phase 36): the API's model did not know isolation: or probes:, both of which the Go loader reads, so a user who set either broke apply-model — the fresh-clone pattern, and two readers of one file disagreeing.
